slides.text: In the summer, Dan and Daria’s families met up.
They went to a sandy beach.
A wave crashed in and destroyed their sandcastle.
Daria said, “Let’s move further away from the ocean.”
They built a new sandcastle farther from the water and it stayed safe from the waves.
